## Aston Villa vs Fulham - Saturday, October 31 (8pm)

### Key Stats

 Aston Villa have won six of their last eight games in all competitions
 Back-to-back league wins has eased the pressure on Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa
 Villa have won six of the last seven meetings between the sides

Recommended Bet

 Aston Villa to win @ 41/50 with LiveScore Bet

### Team News [...] ### Team News

Villa boss Unai Emery rotated heavily for the midweek Carabao Cup defeat to Bournemouth and with no fresh injury concerns, is likely to revert back to the side that beat Manchester City last weekend.

Ryan Sessegnon is Fulham's only confirmed absentee as he serves the final match of his three-game ban for being sent off against Hull.

### Need to Know [...] ### Need to Know

Aston Villa have won their last three home matches — two in the Champions League and one against Manchester City — by a combined score of 11-2.

Fulham's last victory at Villa Park came all the way back in 2014, although they did win the last time the two sides met — a 1-0 success at Craven Cottage towards the end of last season.
